caption: The drawing depicts a single strip of lace, rendered in fine detail, positioned horizontally in the center of a plain, light-colored background. The lace appears to be a pale beige or off-white color. It features a geometric and floral pattern: the upper edge runs mostly straight and is bordered by a tightly-woven band, while the lower edge is scalloped with rounded, repeating circular motifs. Each circle is intricately filled with a lattice design and surrounded by small, radiating loops. Above the row of circles, there is a zigzag pattern, with triangular points extending upwards, and additional latticework filling the spaces within the triangles. The overall composition is centered on the page, and the background is unembellished and free of any other objects or markings, aside from a lightly inscribed text in the lower right area.
title: Lace Edging
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
